breakdown.description: The prompt sets the torsional shear stress to zero at the outer surface, even though the torsional shear stress is maximal there for a solid circular shaft.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly omits the erroneous instruction that torsional shear stress vanishes at the outer surface. Instead, it properly includes the torsional shear stress (τxy = computed torsional shear stress) in the plane stress state for computing principal stresses, which aligns with the ground truth that the shear stress is maximal at the outer surface of a solid circular shaft.
